question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elocaution"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Elocution"**. (वाक्पटुता)

 
 
• **Example: **She took** elocution** lessons to improve her public speaking skills.
 
 
 
• **"Elocution"** refers to the skill of clear and expressive speech, especially of distinct pronunciation and articulation. (वाक्पटुता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **elocution** was so perfect that everyone in the audience could understand her clearly.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Preclude** (अवरोध करना): To prevent from happening; make impossible.

 
 
• **Example:** The high cost of the project precludes its completion by the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Cryptic** (रहस्यमय): Having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure.
 
 
• **Example:** The cryptic message left everyone puzzled.
 
 
 
• **Ethereality** (नाजुकता): The quality of being light, airy, or delicate in a way that seems too perfect for this world.
 
 
• **Example:** The ethereality of the ballerina's performance captivated the audience.
